jane.direct.confirm: I understand the risks; connect directly

jane.sync.confirm_move_hint_compact: Confirm to back up and move mods

jane.compat.title: Jane · Client Compatibility Review
jane.compat.intro1: Jane verified the exact files required by this server.
jane.compat.intro2: The following mods are outside the server-required baseline and exist only on this client.
jane.compat.intro3: These extra mods may cause client compatibility issues.
jane.compat.other: Other mods not required by server
jane.compat.other_warning: These mods do not declare a client-only environment; Jane does not recommend disabling them automatically.
jane.compat.boundary1: Jane synchronizes and verifies the server-required exact mod files.
jane.compat.boundary2: Compatibility of additional client mods with the server, renderer, or other components is outside that baseline.
jane.compat.boundary3: Direct Join preserves every extra mod without changes.
jane.compat.boundary4: If client-only crashes, rendering, or UI issues occur, try disabling extras and testing again.
jane.compat.disable_hint: Disabling never permanently deletes JARs. After Minecraft closes, they move out of mods into Jane's directory.
jane.compat.dependency_warning: Disabling client mods may prevent dependent mods from starting. Jane will not alter unselected mods.
jane.compat.confirm_explain: These files move out of mods after Minecraft closes.
jane.compat.local_file_error: Local file error; disable helper was not started. See the log.
jane.compat.launch_failed: Could not start the local disable helper; Minecraft remains open.
jane.compat.save_failed: Could not save local acknowledgement. Check the Jane directory.
jane.compat.reconnect_failed: Automatic reconnect failed. Please reconnect manually.
jane.select.screen_hint: Clearly required files are included automatically; adjust uncertain candidates and sources here.
jane.select.start_resolution: Sync checks file sources; uncertain candidates can be adjusted separately.
jane.select.ready_to_restart: %s selected files are ready; close the game to install.
jane.select.selected_ready: %s selected files are ready; %s unsatisfied entries remain unselected.
jane.select.required_hint: Clearly server-required files are included automatically. To skip sync, return to Environment Check and choose Direct Join.
jane.select.optional_group: Mods with uncertain client install need
jane.select.optional_hint: Trusted file metadata only informs the recommendation. Candidates are selected by default and can be adjusted individually.
jane.select.optional_empty: There are no adjustable candidates right now.

jane.select.declaration2: Candidates are recommended by default. Deselecting one does not satisfy it if it remains in the server Required Manifest.
jane.select.declaration3: Jane verifies files it downloads. To skip the entire sync, return to Environment Check and review the risks first.
jane.select.audit_incomplete: The decision log is incomplete; see latest.log.
jane.select.reconnect_failed: Automatic reconnect failed. Return to review or retry manually.

jane.risk.explain1: You chose not to install some files listed by this server.
jane.risk.explain2: These files may be needed to join or run correctly. Skipping them may cause a failed connection, missing features, or a client crash.
jane.risk.explain3: Jane records this choice and will show unsatisfied requirements again. Confirming a skip does not mean the files passed verification.
jane.risk.confirm: I understand the risks; try joining
jane.risk.selection_changed: The selection changed. Return to the sync list and review it again.
jane.risk.audit_continue: The decision log is incomplete. Click again to continue.

jane.sync.download_paused: Download paused; verified files are retained.
